title: CAOS executive view data, version 2.0.0
description: The one data file a CAOS product fills for the executive view of its Introduction (content/executive.json). Every text is { en, es }; nothing outside these fields is allowed. The writing limits (30 words per sentence, an answer of at most 2 sentences, one sentence for initiative, vision, statement, exec_problem and caption, no equation, no inline citation, no promotional or client-bound wording), the four_cs rule (absent until FOUR_CS names the 4 C's), the sources-by-field rule and the source-text rules (a source is an https link; its title and note cite no file) are checked by validateExecutive in executive.ts, on top of this structure.

executive.description: One C-suite role, never a list.

organisation.description: One industry and one context, never several regions.

initiative.description: One sentence: what that executive owns and must achieve.

deadline.description: One date or deadline, for example 'by 1 December 2026'.

vision.description: One sentence: what changes for the executive's business. Comes first in section 2.

capability.description: What the product does, in plain words.

statement.description: A one-line statement of the proof point.

four_cs.description: Exactly 4 rows in the owner's order. Absent while FOUR_CS is empty; required, with c equal to the name, once it holds 4 names.

exec_problem.description: One sentence tying the C to this executive's problem.

question.description: A business question that executive asks.

sources.description: The source of every figure (why_now.figure and each outcomes[i].proof), by field path; shown as numbered linked notes, never inline. A source is always a link.

url.x-pattern-message: must be an https:// link (the page or document itself, no other scheme, no spaces)
url.description: The https link to the page or document.

note.description: Optional, at most one sentence, for example a page number. Never a file name or number.

file.description: The inline SVG: one path, or one path per language.

caption.description: One sentence saying what the reader should take from the illustration.
